detail.longDescription: Cron's @ Reboot doesn't track reboots. It runs the first time cron starts while /run/crond.reboot doesn't exist. A container keeps /run across docker restart and host reboots, so @ Reboot never runs again until you recreate it. We tested six crons: # cron # docker # selfhosted https:// runwisp.com/blog/cron-reboot/
